WITH filtered_standings AS (
  SELECT driverId, points, wins
  FROM driverStandings
  WHERE points > 1.0
),
driver_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    driverId,
    AVG(points) as avg_points,
    AVG(wins) as avg_wins
  FROM filtered_standings
  GROUP BY driverId
),
overall_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_mean_wins
  FROM driver_averages
  WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL
),
driver_differences AS (
  SELECT 
    d.driverId,
    d.avg_points,
    d.avg_wins,
    CASE 
      WHEN d.avg_wins IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_mean_wins IS NOT NULL 
        THEN d.avg_wins - o.overall_mean_wins
      ELSE NULL
    END as difference
  FROM driver_averages d
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean_calc o
)
SELECT 
  driverId,
  avg_points,
  avg_wins,
  difference
FROM driver_differences
ORDER BY 
  difference IS NULL,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10
